novel_features.name: Local Cost Analytics
novel_features.description: Query locally cached reporting data without API rate limit friction.
novel_features.rationale: No CLI offers SQLite-backed reporting cache; UA teams hit rate limits on large-scale live queries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you need cross-campaign aggregations or historical trending without burning API quota.

novel_features.name: Bid Optimization Suggestions
novel_features.description: Get CPA/ROAS-driven bid adjustment suggestions with revenue impact forecast before applying.
novel_features.rationale: UA teams test bids manually; no CLI models bid elasticity or forecasts cost impact per keyword.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before bulk bid changes to preview expected spend delta and install rate impact.

novel_features.name: Search Term Auto-Promotion
novel_features.description: Batch analyze high-converting search terms and promote them to keywords with smart match-type routing.
novel_features.rationale: Existing CLIs have manual promote; no CLI applies match-type heuristics for optimal match-type selection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use weekly to surface converting search terms that should become targeted keywords.

novel_features.name: Budget Burn Forecasting
novel_features.description: Predict daily/monthly spend and flag campaigns on track to overshoot budget caps.
novel_features.rationale: No CLI models spend pacing; UA managers discover budget exhaustion after the fact.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use at start of month to catch pacing issues before they become wasted budget.

novel_features.name: Cross-Org Campaign Templates
novel_features.description: Version-control campaign structures and apply them across multiple org IDs with a diff preview.
novel_features.rationale: Multi-app UA teams manually copy campaign structures across orgs; no CLI offers templating or sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when managing multiple apps to ensure consistent campaign structure across all orgs.

narrative.headline: Every Apple Search Ads feature, plus local cost analytics, bid optimization, and cross-org templating no Python CLI offers.
narrative.value_prop: apple-search-ads-pp-cli is a native Go CLI covering all campaign, keyword, and reporting operations plus a local SQLite cache for offline analytics. UA teams get bid optimization suggestions, budget pacing forecasts, and cross-org template sync without hitting API rate limits.
narrative.auth_narrative: Apple Search Ads uses OAuth 2.0 with a private key JWT flow. You need a client ID, team ID, key ID, org ID, and a .p8 private key file. Run `apple-search-ads-pp-cli auth setup` to configure these, or set ASA_CLIENT_ID, ASA_TEAM_ID, ASA_KEY_ID, ASA_ORG_ID, and ASA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH in your environment.

quickstart.comment: Verify auth config and API reachability
List all campaigns across your org
See keyword analytics from the local cache

troubleshoots.fix: Run `apple-search-ads-pp-cli auth setup` -- your private key or client ID may be expired or misconfigured
Check ASA_ORG_ID matches the org you're targeting; different orgs need different credentials
Use `analytics sync-cache` first, then query locally with `analytics query`

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when managing Apple Search Ads campaigns from the command line, automating bid adjustments, analyzing keyword performance at scale, or building UA automation pipelines.
anti_triggers: App Store Connect app metadata or screenshots (use App Store Connect CLI or Fastlane)
Attribution analytics (use MMP tools like AppsFlyer or Adjust)
